title: Detail: On-Demand Cleaning
shortDescription: Find cleaners for your home or car, compare offers and book in one app.
fullDescription:
Detail helps customers find cleaning professionals for homes and cars. Post a cleaning job, review offers and choose the cleaner that works for you.

With Detail you can:
• Describe the cleaning you need and add photos.
• Compare cleaner offers and manage bookings.
• Message your cleaner about the job.
• Keep track of your booking and review your experience.
• Find cleaning work and respond to jobs as a cleaner.

Available features and services may vary by location and account status.
